name: manankarnik/bevy_generative
description: A Bevy engine plugin for real-time procedural generation of maps, textures, terrain, and planets using noise and configurable parameters. Provides a unified API for multiple generation types within the Bevy ECS framework.
score_rationale: The primary procedural generation plugin for the rapidly growing Bevy ecosystem covering terrain, planets, and textures in one package.
summary: Bevy plugin for real-time procedural generation of terrain, planets, maps, and textures.
